# JMSFusionV2 4.0

Major release of the independent WhatsCS fork of MonWUI / JMSFusion, originally developed by G-grbz and upstream contributors. Licensed under GPLv3.

## Changes

- Bundle browser entry points with esbuild, shared chunks, and minified assets.
- Preserve embedded modules required by dynamic settings and language imports.
- Defer slider refresh while the page is scrolled.
- Include backend/frontend cleanup, translation updates, and technical documentation.
- Maintain manifest version history and calculate checksums from release archives.

## Upgrade

This fork uses the JMSFusionV2 assembly, routes, and configuration identity. Upgrades from the original JMSFusion plugin may require reinstalling and reconfiguring the fork; do not assume automatic migration. Back up settings before upgrading.

Targets Jellyfin 10.11.0 and .NET 9. Restart Jellyfin and hard refresh Jellyfin Web after installation. Native Android TV clients are not supported.

## Validation

Release build passed. Assembly version 4.0.0.0, embedded browser bundles, dynamic settings/language modules, and ZIP contents were verified. Existing duplicate-key warnings were emitted by the asset bundler. Runtime validation in Jellyfin Web was unavailable; no performance benchmark or compatibility with newer Jellyfin versions is claimed.

v3.7.0.2-dev

Fixes:
- Restored embedded slider modules required by runtime dynamic imports
- Settings and language module URLs are available again

Notes:
- Development build from perf-improvements
- Restart Jellyfin and hard refresh Jellyfin Web after updating
